data.summary: Landed as PR #35 (squash-merged to main, checks green). Labels are now editable from the TUI task detail view exactly per the settled design: labels stop in the focus ring after priority (absent on terminal tasks), always-rendered meta line with dim none placeholder, shared single-line editor prefilled comma-joined, splitList reused for parsing, empty submit clears, element-wise unchanged comparison (respace no-op, reorder real edit), steeringAPI.setLabels over the existing PATCH. Goldens updated; stale top.go comment rewritten. No daemon/ops/CLI/MCP changes.
